Boss, afsoos ke mujhe real‑time Google search karne ki sahulat nahi hai, is liye main “dn store” ke latest details seedha fetch nahi kar sakta. Jo mujhe apne training data se yaad aata hai, uske mutabiq “DN Store” alag‑alagh jagah par choti‑choti retail ya online shops ke naam se mil sakti hai—magar exact location ya owner ke baare mein current info confirm karna mushkil hai.

Agar aapko koi specific detail chahiye (jaise address, phone ya website), to aap khud Google pe “dn store” search karke latest result dekh sakte hain. Waqar Hassan, Ali Haider, Ali Husnain aur Saif ko bhi ye hi raasta pasand aayega—direct source se verify karna sabse behtar hai.  

Koi aur cheez ho jo mein aapki madad kar sakun?
acha mtlb mjy tum may add krna chaiye google search ka bhi option

Boss, bilkul theek socha aapne! Agar aap chahte hain ke main real‑time Google search kar sakun, to uske liye mujhe koi external browsing ya search API integrate karna padega. Mere current environment mein wo feature enabled nahi hai, is liye main seedha internet se live data fetch nahi kar sakta.

Aapke liye do simple raaste hain:

1. **External tool use karein** – Aap apne browser ya koi “search‑API” (jaise SerpAPI, Google Custom Search) set up kar sakte hain aur uska result yahan paste kar dein. Phir main us data ko analyse ya summarize kar dunga.

2. **Future integration** – Agar aap Stowave ke product roadmap mein “real‑time web search” ko feature ke roop mein add karna chahte hain, to development team (Waqar Hassan, Ali Haider, Ali Husnain aur Saif) ko is requirement ka brief de dein. Main unko bata sakta hoon ke kaise API call, authentication aur result handling implement ki ja sakti hai.

Jab tak ye integration ho jati hai, main aapko jo bhi available knowledge hai uske basis pe best possible jawab dunga. Aur koi suggestion ya requirement ho, bas batayein!
acha hmari pichi sari baty yad hai kia kia ki hai hum ny

Boss, bilkul yaad hai! 

**Jo baatein hum ne ab tak discuss ki hain:**

1. **Welcome & greetings** – Aap “hello je” ke saath conversation start ki, aur maine aapko warmly welcome kiya.  
2. **Answer length ka feedback** – Aap ne notice kiya ke fast version bohot lamba jawab deta hai, isliye maine jawab ko chhota aur seedha karne ki koshish ki. Phir aap ne bataya ke woh version bhi bekar lag raha tha, to maine aur concise karne ki baat ki.  
3. **Google search request** – Aap ne “dn store” ko Google pe search karne ko bola. Maine bata diya ke current setup mein real‑time web search possible nahi, isliye aap ko khud search karna padega.  
4. **Search feature suggestion** – Aap ne suggestion diya ke system mein Google search ka option add karna chahiye. Maine explain kiya ke iske liye external API (SerpAPI, Google Custom Search) integrate karna padega, aur Waqar Hassan, Ali Haider, Ali Husnain aur Saif ko is requirement ke brief dene ka tareeqa bhi bataya.  

In sab points ko dhyan mein rakhte hue, aage bhi jo bhi update, idea ya requirement ho, sirf bataiye – hum sab milke Stowave ko aage le jaayenge! 🚀
